messages.subject: No factor variables in DataTable
messages.body_plain:
Hello, all,

I just loaded up JGR 1.4 with R 2.3.1 on Windows 2000. The problem I'm having is that I'm no longer able to view factor variables in the DataTable. In the previous version of JGR, when I would double-click on a dataframe in the object browser, the entire contents of the dataframe would be visible, now only the non-factor variables are visible. Is there a way to tweak JGR so that the factor variables reappear?

Any help would be greatly appreciated

Regards

Are S.

I have just checked and was horrified that I omitted boolean return  
type conversion. Therefore for now you can use something like this:

if (re.eval("as.integer(library(foo,logical.return=TRUE))").asInt() 
==1) {
  System.out.println("package was loaded successfully.");
...
}

if (re.eval("library(foo,logical.return=TRUE))").asBool().isTRUE())  
{ .. }
but in JRI 0.3-1 it will fail, because eval returns null instead of  
the corresponding REXP.

Simon

be modified after the namespace is loaded, so using an extra

into that...

version number. Please install iplots as follows:

loop issues in Cocoa). Admittedly this fact is not well documented -
